description.value: A backcountry wilderness campsite within Strathcona Provincial Park—BC's oldest park—set in a rugged mountain landscape of peaks, rivers, and old-growth forest; access is hike-in only, facilities are minimal or absent, and the remote character is the entire point.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record tags Butterwort Flats Campsite as a tourism=camp_site within Strathcona Park and links to the general bcparks.ca/strathcona-park/ page. The website confirms Strathcona Park is an active, operational provincial park but provides no campsite-specific amenity details for Butterwort Flats itself. All amenity values therefore default to null; the only confirmed facts are the park's operational status and the working website URL.
concerns: Website URL resolves to the general Strathcona Park overview page, not a page specific to Butterwort Flats Campsite; no amenity-level information is available for this site.
No address or phone number present in OSM record.
It is unclear whether this is a frontcountry vehicle-accessible site or a backcountry/walk-in site; access type for loaded cycle-tourists is unconfirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Butterwort Flats Campsite is a real named site within an active provincial park, but the linked website covers only the general Strathcona Park overview with no campsite-specific amenity details; a dedicated listing page (e.g. camping.bcparks.ca) is needed to confirm cyclist-relevant features before inclusion.
enrichment_extras.notes: BC Parks general contact available at bcparks.ca/contact/: 1-800-689-9025 (toll-free Canada/US), parkinfo@gov.bc.ca. A more specific campsite record may exist at camping.bcparks.ca.
